Sankey diagram: functions (KO/EC/MetaCyc) to taxa/features

fun2tax_sankey.Rd

The input pathway_sdaa_result must be a **named list** where names are function IDs (KO/EC/MetaCyc), and each element is a data frame containing at least feature (target/taxon), logFC, and one multiple-testing column (e.g., p_adjust, padj, qval, FDR). The function:

  1. normalizes function IDs (e.g., strips 'ko:', 'ec:'),

  2. (optionally) maps IDs to higher-level groups using reference tables shipped in MicroFun (inst/extdata/*_reference.RData),

  3. assembles edges source to target (group or function → taxon),

  4. uses one unit of width per retained association,

  5. colors links by direction (Up/Down), and

  6. returns an interactive networkD3 sankey widget.

Usage

fun2tax_sankey(
  pathway_sdaa_result,
  pathway = c("KO", "EC", "MetaCyc"),
  group_functions = TRUE,
  taxa_list = NULL,
  node_color = c(Up = "#F5BB7C", Down = "#B4CBE0"),
  node_neutral = NULL,
  label_left_sources = TRUE,
  margin = list(top = 10, right = 200, bottom = 10, left = 180),
  height = 1200,
  width = 1000,
  taxon_palette = microfun_palette("taxa"),
  function_palette = microfun_palette("function"),
  taxon_groups = NULL,
  tree_mode = c("none", "taxonomy", "phylogeny"),
  physeq = NULL,
  taxonomy = NULL,
  phylo_tree = NULL,
  tree_file = NULL,
  picrust2_dir = NULL,
  taxon_level = NULL,
  taxonomy_ranks = NULL,
  tree_tip_level = c("ASV", "taxon"),
  show_branch_length = TRUE,
  missing_taxa = c("error", "drop"),
  tree_options = list(),
  phylogeny_order = c("median", "first")
)

Arguments

pathway_sdaa_result

Named list. Names are function IDs (KO/EC/MetaCyc). Each element is a data frame with columns including:

  • feature: target/taxon (e.g., genus) label,

  • logFC: signed effect estimate,

  • a q/p-adjust column (any of: p_adjust, padj, qval, q_value, qvalue, p.adj, FDR, p_adj).

pathway

Character. Functional namespace of the names in pathway_sdaa_result; one of 'KO', 'EC', 'MetaCyc'.

group_functions

Logical. If TRUE, map function IDs to higher groups before linking to taxa (KO to PathwayL1; EC/MetaCyc to description). Requires reference files in MicroFun's inst/extdata.

taxa_list

Optional character vector. If provided, keep only edges whose source (group label or function ID) matches one of these entries.

node_color

Named character vector of length 2 with colors for link groups: names must be c('Up','Down'). Default: orange for Up ('#F5BB7C'), blue for Down ('#B4CBE0').

node_neutral

Optional single colour overriding both node palettes. NULL (default) uses the light taxa and dark function palettes.

label_left_sources

Logical. If TRUE, left-side node labels are right-aligned and wrapped via JavaScript for readability. Default TRUE.

margin

Named list with pixel margins top, right, bottom, left. Passed to networkD3::sankeyNetwork().

height, width

Numeric. Output size in pixels for the widget canvas.

taxon_palette

Light taxon colours; optionally named by colour category.

function_palette

Dark function colours; optionally named by category.

taxon_groups

Optional named character vector mapping each taxon name to a taxonomy category such as Phylum. Without it, taxa are coloured by name.

tree_mode

Side tree: 'none' (networkD3), 'taxonomy', or 'phylogeny'.

physeq

Optional phyloseq object with original ASV taxonomy/tree.

taxonomy

Taxonomy data.frame/matrix; ASV row names or ASV/FeatureID column.

phylo_tree

A phylo object or named list of independent phylo trees.

tree_file

Newick file path(s). Each file must contain one tree.

picrust2_dir

PICRUSt2 output folder. Prefers reduced domain trees, then out.tre.

taxon_level

Rank inferred from recorded analysis settings; otherwise Genus. Use 'ASV' for ASV IDs.

taxonomy_ranks

Ordered ranks used for the taxonomic side tree; NULL uses available ancestors.

tree_tip_level

'ASV' matches tree tips to taxonomy row IDs; 'taxon' requires already taxon-labelled tips.

show_branch_length

Use available phylogenetic branch lengths; otherwise topology only.

missing_taxa

'error' (default) or 'drop' for taxa without matched tree tips.

tree_options

Named list: title, subtitle, font_size, font_family, tree_width, node_width, node_gap, show_tip_labels, tree_colour, link_opacity. Also accepts aggregate_links, collapse_clades, bundle_mapping and show_footer.

phylogeny_order

Taxon ordering in phylogeny mode: 'median' (default) uses the median displayed ASV tip position; 'first' uses the first tip position. Median ties use the first tip position. Tree topology determines tip order. Used only in phylogeny mode.

Details

Build an interactive Sankey diagram linking functional features (KO, EC, or MetaCyc IDs) — optionally grouped to higher-level categories — to taxa or features reported in differential analysis results (e.g., from pathway_sdaa()).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Minimal toy example
sdaa_list <- list(
  K00001 = data.frame(feature = c('GenusA','GenusB'),
                      logFC = c( 1.1, -0.4),
                      p_adjust = c(0.02, 0.3)),
  K00002 = data.frame(feature = c('GenusB','GenusC'),
                      logFC = c(-1.6,  0.5),
                      p_adjust = c(0.01, 0.7))
)

# Function to taxon (no grouping)
p1 <- fun2tax_sankey(sdaa_list, pathway = 'KO', group_functions = FALSE)
p1

# Group functions to higher-level categories (requires reference files)
p2 <- fun2tax_sankey(sdaa_list, pathway = 'KO', group_functions = TRUE)
p2
} # }
